newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-Holiday saps India trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-Holiday saps India trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts took a breather as the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) closed for the start of a holiday season.
"It Wednesday before the Bombay market opens again for real trading and no one wants to take positions ahead of that," said a trader.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI closed up just 0.24 points at 61.75, with the premium over the local market at 15.67 percent compared with yesterday's 14.32 percent.
The GDR market rose almost two percent yesterday and is down just under 20 percent over the year.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index was closed for a holiday and normal trade will resume Wednesday, but the National was open and added 10.0 points at 885.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended up 0.77 points at 64.91, a premium of 25.95 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite Index fell 2.65 points to a provisional 739.11.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index fell 0.26 points to 90.16, a premium of 0.99 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index lost 47.72 points or 0.72 percent to 6,581.96.
